resources.string: Grant Do Not Disturb access in the Quick Tiles app to change this volume
Adds 10 Quick Settings tiles: volume up and volume down for Media, Ringtone, Notification, Alarm and Call.
1. Swipe down twice to open Quick Settings, tap the edit (pencil) button and drag the Quick Tiles tiles into your panel.
2. Ringtone and Notification tiles need Do Not Disturb access to lower the volume to vibrate or silent.
Do Not Disturb access: not granted
